summary: Axia Energia filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval to redeem 576,923 Class C preferred shares (PNCs) for R$30 million total, at R$52.00 per share (the closing price of common shares on June 12, 2026). The transaction is a first-time, small-scale redemption to test the mechanism. Shareholders may elect to convert PNCs into common shares at 1:1 ratio through June 29, 2026, instead of redemption. ADR holders are excluded from conversion and will receive cash. Payment is set for July 7, 2026. The redemption reduces preferred equity by 0.0951% of that class. Watch for future larger-scale redemptions or conversions, and market reaction to the redemption price mechanism.
